cover_letter:
Dear Jurimesh team,

I'm writing to apply for the Content & Growth Marketeer role. Your ad says you're looking for someone who can own content and events, build inbound, and figure things out without a playbook. That's exactly how I've worked for the past two years.

As a freelancer and at Episto, I've built and optimized websites, written SEO content that ranks, and used AI tools daily to automate the repetitive work. I've designed and built sites in WordPress, implemented structured data and llms.txt for AI search visibility, and run technical SEO audits that measurably improved search health. I also have a technical background: I spent a year as a front-end developer and I still code, which means I can build the landing page as well as write the post.

I'm fluent in English and native in Turkish, with Dutch at B1 writing level. I'm comfortable in a startup environment where the plan can change on Wednesday, and I'd rather do ten things well enough to learn than one thing perfectly.

One thing I'd change about your marketing today: the blog reads like it's written for other legal-tech people, not for an M&A partner who needs to forward it to a colleague. I'd interview a few of your customers and rewrite the top posts around the questions they actually get asked in deals. I'd also experiment with formats that make people stop scrolling, like short video interviews with partners about the messiest part of their diligence process.

I'd love to talk about how I can help you reach more qualified inbound and build awareness in the M&A world.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
